fullPassage: A cornerstone of the scientific method is replication, meaning that the exact same results are obtained whenever an experiment is repeated. It can be argued that any experiment that cannot be replicated is by definition invalid. Unfortunately, this has proven to be the inconvenient truth for many studies in the social sciences —a problem that has come to be known in academic circles as the replication crisis. In the early 2000s, psychologists and sociologists began examining the most influential experiments from the previous century with a more critical eye, leading to a number of failed attempts to duplicate their findings. The issue wasn’t limited to the past —another study revealed that only around one-third of papers published in social science journals at the time included reproducible results. The disclosure was a serious setback for the field’s reputation. However, it cannot be said that the effects of the replication crisis have been wholly negative. Researchers are now developing a more systematic approach to ensure reproducibility before experiment results are published.

Unfortunately, many of these studies could not ④<u>duplicated</u> at all.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: ④ duplicated → be duplicated: 'could not' 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하고, 수동이므로 'be duplicated'로 써요.
det.analysis:
① Known(알려진) — 'Known as ~, a problem has troubled' 수동 분사구문이라 적절해요

② repeated(반복된) — 'an experiment repeated under the same conditions' 명사를 꾸미는 과거분사라 적절해요

③ began(시작했다) — 'researchers began to re-examine' 과거시제라 적절해요

④ duplicated — 'many of these studies could not __________'은 조동사 뒤 원형+수동이라 be duplicated가 맞아요. duplicated 단독은 틀려요 ←정답(틀린 곳)
det.tip: could not be duplicated (조동사 + be + p.p.).

questions.passage: A cornerstone of the scientific method is replication, meaning that the exact same results are obtained whenever an experiment is repeated. It can be argued that any experiment that cannot be replicated is by definition invalid. Unfortunately, this has proven to be the inconvenient truth for many studies in the social sciences —a problem that has come to be known in academic circles as the replication crisis. In the early 2000s, psychologists and sociologists began examining the most influential experiments from the previous century with a more critical eye, leading to a number of failed attempts to duplicate their findings. The issue wasn’t limited to the past —another study revealed that only around one-third of papers published in social science journals at the time included reproducible results. The disclosure was a serious setback for the field’s reputation. However, it cannot be said that the effects of the replication crisis have been wholly negative. Researchers are now developing a more systematic approach to ensure reproducibility before experiment results are published.
questions.stem:

사회과학 저널에 실린 논문 중 약 3분의 1에만 포함되어 있던 것

det.korean: reproducible results = 재현 가능한 결과
det.analysis: 본문 'only around one-third of papers published in social science journals at the time included reproducible results'에서, 3분의 1에만 포함되어 있던 것은 reproducible results(재현 가능한 결과)예요.
det.tip: only one-third ~ included ______ → reproducible results.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 해당하는 부분을 본문에서 찾아 (5단어, 영어로) 쓰시오.

det.analysis: 본문 'Researchers are now developing a more systematic approach to ensure reproducibility'에서 '더 체계적인 접근법을 개발하는 것'에 해당하는 부분은 developing a more systematic approach예요.

questions.passage: However, it cannot be __________ (say) that the effects of the replication crisis have been wholly negative. Researchers are now developing a more systematic approach to ensure reproducibility.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: say → said: 'cannot be + p.p.' 수동태라 과거분사 said로 바꿔요.
det.analysis:
'it cannot be __________ that ~'는 'be동사(be) + ______'로 수동태예요. '~라고 말해질(여겨질) 수 없다'는 뜻이니 say를 과거분사 said로 바꿔요.

→ 따라서 say를 said로 써요.
det.tip: it cannot be said that = ~라고 할 수 없다 (수동태).

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 재현성 위기가 평판에 타격을 줬지만, 더 체계적인 연구 관행이라는 긍정적 변화도 이끌었다는 것이 요지예요.
det.analysis:

② 약 3분의 1만 재현에 성공했어요

④ 'wholly negative'는 아니라고 했으니 긍정적 면도 있어요
det.tip: 타격 + 더 나은 연구 관행.

ch: 모든 과학 실험은 반복할 필요가 없다.

재현성 위기는 오직 부정적인 결과만 낳았다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 [조건]의 단어를 모두 사용하여 (영어로) 쓰시오.

과학적 방법의 초석은 재현성이다.
[조건] (1) A, cornerstone, is, method, of, replication, scientific, the 를 모두 사용 (2) 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '~의 초석'을 A cornerstone of ~로, '재현성이다'를 is replication으로 영작해요.
det.analysis:
주어는 A cornerstone of the scientific method(과학적 방법의 초석)예요.

→ 'of the scientific method'가 cornerstone을 뒤에서 꾸며요.

→ 동사는 is, 보어는 replication(재현성)이에요.

→ 완성: A cornerstone of the scientific method is replication
det.tip: A cornerstone of ~ = ~의 초석 (of가 뒤에서 수식).
